id: -2270-薩爾貢大帝在阿卡德帝國東北部的戰役
theater: 迪亞拉河谷與札格羅斯山前線

battle.name: 薩爾貢大帝在阿卡德帝國東北部的戰役
battle.theater: 迪亞拉河谷與札格羅斯山前線
battle.brief: 公元前2270年，阿卡德王國在薩爾貢大帝治下，於國土東北部的迪亞拉河谷與札格羅斯山前線對古提人、盧魯比人等山部勢力用兵。戰役以步兵方陣持銅矛正面進攻，配合弓手齊射與攻城槌破壞山城。卡面的埃及長矛屬早王朝青銅工藝，與本役同屬銅器時代的刺擊兵器譜系，並非本役現場的出土遺物。

kit.name: 埃及長矛
kit.history: 早王朝時期的長矛，銅或青銅矛頭綁在木杆上。埃及人用它守城垣，後來也用它收復失地。

countries: 這場戰爭是阿卡德王國在薩爾貢大帝治下，於自身疆域東北一隅發動的邊境戰役，年代約在公元前2270年，戰場在今伊拉克中部的迪亞拉河谷、基法拉（Tell Hafajah）一帶及其背後的札格羅斯山麓。交戰的一方是阿卡德王國：薩爾貢以王室的「四方之王」身分統率，他的部隊是職業化的常備軍，兵種以步兵為主，含有持矛的密集方陣、持斧的近戰兵與弓手；最高指揮由國王本人、其子曼尼什圖什與各城的總督（sakkanakku）分擔，軍令以王室文告下達，王室還派「城鎮首長」一級的官員駐在新建的據點。阿卡德一方在東北線的實際作戰單位，是新設立的北部行省及其境內的一系列王室城邑，這套「行省加直屬城」的配置是這一時期的制度特點。對手是分布在上美索不達米亞與西南伊朗山區的幾個部族聯盟：古提人、盧魯比人，還有被阿卡德文獻歸入「北方／蘇巴拉爾圖」的人群，他們以山寨與谷地為據點，並不建立集中的王權，作戰多以游擊與據點抵抗的方式進行。第三方則是被同一體系覆蓋或牽動的南方埃蘭人：東線的局勢使薩爾貢必須在東北投入兵力的同時，仍要留一支力量照看東南。正因如此，東北線的戰役對阿卡德而言不是一場可有可無的邊境摩擦，而是整個王權版圖能否成形的前提。
countriesEn: This war was a frontier campaign launched by the kingdom of Akkad under Sargon the Great in the north-eastern corner of its own territory, dated to about 2270 BC, fought in the Diyala valley and around Tell Hafajah in what is now central Iraq and along the foot of the Zagros beyond it. One side was the kingdom of Akkad: Sargon, bearing the royal title 'King of the Four Quarters', commanded a standing professional army made up chiefly of infantry, with a dense spear formation, axe-men for close work, and archers; the supreme command was shared between the king himself, his son Manishtushu and the provincial governors (sakkanakku) of the towns, the orders of the campaign went out in the form of royal proclamations, and the crown posted its own officials of the 'herald of the city' rank in the newly founded strongholds. The Akkadian force actually operating on the north-eastern line was the newly constituted northern province and the chain of royal cities within it, a 'province plus directly held cities' arrangement that is a feature of the institutions of this period. The opponents were a number of tribal confederacies spread across Upper Mesopotamia and the mountains of south-western Iran: the Gutians and the Lullubi, together with the populations that the Akkadian texts group under 'the north / Subartu'. They held their strongholds in the valleys and the mountains, had no centralised kingship, and fought mainly by harrying the roads and holding fortified positions. A third party was the Elamites to the south, whose position on the eastern line obliged Sargon to keep a force in hand for the south-east while he committed his strength in the north-east. It is for this reason that the north-eastern campaign was not an optional border skirmish for Akkad, but the precondition for the shape of the whole imperial map.
people: 薩爾貢大帝是這場戰爭的策劃者與象徵核心。他早年在寧孫與烏姆的鬥爭中取勝，於前2334年前後建立阿卡德，並在位數十年間以「四方之王」的名號整合蘇美爾城邦、阿卡德、埃蘭與北方山地。史料顯示他在生命的最後十年仍不斷向東北用兵，理由不只是報復，而是把邊境變成王室的直屬領地。直接在前線指揮的將領在傳世文本中多數沒有留下名字，這本身就是這場戰爭記載稀薄的一個特徵：阿卡德王室的戰報習慣以國王本人的身分作結，只有少數銘文出現「某某率軍」的句式，說明當時的指揮結構仍以王權為核心、以官署為輔助。其子曼尼什圖什是繼承人，據說曾隨父出征，後來以父之名延續北方政策，並在盧魯比山麓留下了著名的「納拉姆辛勝利石碑」，那件碑面把人類學上最像軍隊的場面保存下來：持矛、持斧的步兵方陣，以及山道上的苦戰。對面的古提與盧魯比首領同樣沒有留下姓名，阿卡德文獻只以「山民」「其首」一類的集稱處理他們，這既是山區政治無中央王權的反映，也讓這場戰爭的敵方面孔在文獻中長期模糊。
peopleEn: Sargon the Great is the planner and the symbolic core of this war. He had won the contest between Ningirsu's city of Lagash and the city of Umma, founded Akkad at about 2334 BC, and over the decades of his reign used the title 'King of the Four Quarters' to bring the Sumerian city-states, Akkad, Elam and the northern mountains under a single kingship. The sources show that he was still campaigning in the north-east in the last ten years of his life, and the reason was not revenge but the conversion of a frontier into territory held directly by the crown. The commanders who actually led the fighting in the field have, for the most part, left no names in the transmitted texts, and that in itself is one of the marks of how thinly this war is recorded: the Akkadian victory accounts habitually conclude in the person of the king himself, and only a few inscriptions use the formula naming a general who led the troops, which shows that the command structure of the day still centred on the royal office with the administrative apparatus in support. His son Manishtushu was the heir, is said to have campaigned with his father, later carried the northern policy forward under his father's name, and left behind in the Lullubi foothills the famous Victory Stele of Naram-Sin, on which is preserved the scene that most resembles an army in the whole of Near Eastern art: a phalanx of spearmen and axe-men, and the hard fight on a mountain track. The chiefs of the Gutians and the Lullubi left no names either; the Akkadian texts handle them only through collective formulas such as 'the mountaineers' or 'their chief'. That is at once a reflection of a mountain politics without centralised kingship and the reason why the enemy face of this war has stayed blurred in the record.
kits: 卡面這件埃及長矛屬早王朝時期的工藝：銅或青銅矛頭以銲接或綁紮方式裝在木杆前端，用途是守城垣與近身刺擊。它與公元前2270年的阿卡德東北戰役相隔約九百年，並不出現在美索不達米亞；阿卡德人手中與之同屬一個技術譜系的，是銅矛，形制相近而細節有別：青銅矛頭套合木杆，但尺寸更短、刃部更寬，適合密集隊形中的推刺。真正代表阿卡德軍隊面貌的是銅斧，即「獅頭斧」與雙刃斧，兼具砍伐與破壞門扉的作用；薩爾貢本人陵墓出土的青銅柄匕首殘件，是極少數可指名歸於薩爾貢的隨身兵器。遠程武器是複合弓，阿卡德弓手在攻城前以齊射覆蓋城頭與城門，箭鏃多以骨、銅或石製。攻城器材方面，阿卡德人有銅鎬、撞擊用的木槌與繩索，並以柴堆封堵門道；薩爾貢時代的軍隊沒有戰車，運輸靠牛拉的載具，這正是方陣長矛得以充當主戰兵器的前提。卡面說明中「守城垣，後來用它收復失地」的敘述，在兩地傳統中並非巧合：阿卡德王室的自我描述，正是「把失地收復、令四方歸一」。
kitsEn: The Egyptian spear on the card belongs to the craftwork of the early dynastic period: a copper or bronze head fitted to the front of a wooden shaft by riveting or binding, made for defending walls and for stabbing at close quarters. It stands roughly nine hundred years away from the Akkadian north-eastern campaign of 2270 BC and did not appear in Mesopotamia; what the Akkadians held that belongs to the same technological family was the copper spear, close in form but differing in detail: a bronze head socketed onto a wooden shaft, shorter in dimension and broader in blade, suited to thrusting in a dense formation. What really marks the character of the Akkadian army is the copper axe, the so-called lion-headed axe and the double-bladed axe, which served both for cutting and for breaking down doors; the fragment of a bronze-hilted dagger from the tomb of Sargon himself is one of the very few pieces of arms that can be tied to Sargon by name. The ranged weapon was the composite bow, and Akkadian archers covered the walls and the gates with massed volleys before an assault, their arrowheads made of bone, copper or stone. For siege work the Akkadians had copper picks, wooden mauls for pounding and rope, and they blocked gateways with stacked brushwood; there were no chariots in Sargon's army, and transport was by ox-drawn vehicles, which is precisely what allowed the spear of the phalanx to serve as the main weapon. The card's own note that it was used to defend walls and later to recover lost territory is no accident in the two traditions: the Akkadian court's self-description was exactly that of recovering what had been lost and bringing the four quarters into one.
tactics: 阿卡德的東北戰役不是一次會戰，而是一系列沿交通線向北推進的連續攻勢，戰術核心是「步兵方陣加上工程控制」。軍隊先以弓手在前射擊，壓制城頭與城門，然後以持矛方陣與斧兵接近城垣，在盾牌的掩護下貼牆作業；對付山城與設防的谷地聚落，使用銅鎬、木槌與柴火破壞門扉與圍牆，再由缺口突入。翻越山區時，隊伍以縱隊沿谷地行進，前鋒與主力之間靠信使保持連絡，遇游擊即以密集隊形應對，而不急於追擊散兵——這一點在納拉姆辛的勝利石碑上看得最清楚：石面下部是成排的持矛步兵與落下來的無數箭鏃，上部是國王率隊沿陡坡前進。山區的糧秣極難保障，遠征成敗往往取決於能否在雨季之前把軍隊送到目標地帶，並就地徵用穀物與鹽。此外，王權的象徵工具也被當成戰術手段使用：在高山立石碑、刻上國王的形象，等於宣告該處已入王權的版圖；阿卡德在東北線的每一次勝利都以這樣的石碑確認，也因此讓對手的抵抗在後世的記憶中一次次被重演。
tacticsEn: The north-eastern campaign of Akkad was not a single pitched battle but a series of connected advances pushed northward along the lines of communication, and the tactical core of it was the infantry phalanx combined with engineering control. The archers opened by shooting from the front, silencing the walls and the gates, and then spearmen and axe-men closed on the rampart and worked along it under the cover of shields; against hill towns and fortified settlements in the valleys, copper picks, wooden mauls and brushwood were used to break down the doors and the enclosure walls, and the troops came in through the gap. When the army crossed the mountains it moved in column along the valleys, with messengers holding contact between the vanguard and the main body, and when it met a raid it answered in close formation rather than chasing scattered men. That last point is clearest on the Victory Stele of Naram-Sin: in the lower register are ranked rows of spearmen and a shower of arrows, and above them the king leads his men up a steep slope. Supply in the mountains was extremely hard to keep up, and the success of a distant campaign generally turned on whether the army could be brought to its objective before the rains and could draw grain and salt on the spot. Moreover the symbolic apparatus of kingship was used as a tactical instrument: setting up a stela high in the mountains with the king's image upon it announced that the place had entered the king's map, and every Akkadian victory in the north-east was confirmed in this way, which is why the resistance of the enemy was reenacted again and again in later memory.
data: 可引的數字有限，而且都須保留。薩爾貢的即位年代一般定在公元前2334年，卒於前2279年，《蘇美爾王表》記其在位三十六年，另有一部抄本記五十六年；本役標出的前2270年落在其統治的末段，距離他最後一次對埃蘭的用兵與身死約九年。地理上，阿卡德的位置至今未定，一般認為在幼發拉底河中游、接近西帕爾一帶，由此到迪亞拉河谷的據點群直線約二百公里，若推進到札格羅斯山中盧魯比人的國度，行程在四百至五百公里之間。文本量本身可以作旁證：現存已知薩爾貢在世時的銘文達數千件，是兩河任何一位君主中最大的同期文本群，但明確屬於東北戰役的只有零星數件，提及古提、盧魯比的銘文更少。考古方面，基法拉與伊什恰利、泰勒比拉（杜爾塔克）等地都有薩爾貢時期的居址層，其中基法拉一處被燒毀的層位出土了一批銅器與集中埋葬的戰士遺骸，數十名戰士隨葬銅斧、匕首與頭盔，可作為這場戰爭裝備與烈度的實物旁證；但至今沒有任何一處遺跡被學界認定為這場戰爭的戰場，戰役的確切交戰日期與地名，仍然只能從王朝的疆界變化與後世正統敘事中去推想。
dataEn: The figures available are limited, and each has to be taken with care. Sargon's accession is generally put at 2334 BC and his death at 2279 BC; the Sumerian King List gives him thirty-six years, and one variant manuscript gives fifty-six. The year marked on this card, 2270 BC, falls in the closing stretch of his reign, about nine years before his last campaign against Elam and his death. Geographically, the site of Akkad is still undetermined and is generally placed in the middle Euphrates near Sippar; the straight line from there to the cluster of strongholds in the Diyala valley is about two hundred kilometres, and the march to the country of the Lullubi deep in the Zagros runs to four or five hundred. The volume of the texts can serve as indirect evidence: several thousand inscriptions made in Sargon's own lifetime are known, the largest body of contemporary texts belonging to any ruler of the two rivers, yet only a few are securely tied to the north-eastern campaign, and those naming the Gutians or the Lullubi are fewer still. On the archaeological side, Akkadian occupation levels have been found at Tell Hafajah, at Ishchali and at Tell Billa (Durtak), and at one burnt level at Hafajah a batch of copper objects and a collective burial of warriors came to light, several tens of men buried with copper axes, daggers and helmets, which serves as material evidence for the equipment and the violence of this war. No archaeological site, however, has been identified by scholars as the battlefield of this particular campaign, and the exact date and place of the fighting can only be inferred from the change in the boundaries of the dynasty and from the dynastic orthodoxy of later times.
cause: 打起來的直接動力是邊境壓力。阿卡德的核心區在兩河中下游，而其北方與東北方的土地由不統一的山地部族控制：古提人、盧魯比人與被歸入蘇巴拉爾圖的北方人群佔據上底格里斯河與迪亞拉河上游的高地，並在阿卡德的城市與王國周邊劫掠、騷擾，妨礙東北商路與牧場的正常使用，使王室無法確定地收取那一帶的貢賦。薩爾貢個人的政治目標則是「四方之王」的完成：把蘇美爾城邦、阿卡德、埃蘭與北方山地的勢力全部納入同一王權的名義之下，並以此鞏固他從寧孫繼承來的合法性與神授的王權身分。已經失去的城市需要被收復，這是阿卡德王室敘事中反覆出現的句式，與卡面兵器說明中的「收復失地」正好同構——不是巧合，而是兩河流域與尼羅河流域王室合法化語言的平行。另外，東北的山地同時掌握著木材、石料與礦產等戰時必需品，佔有它們就等於佔有阿卡德繼續壯大的物質條件，這使得每一次東北用兵都具有雙重意義：既是邊防，也是擴張。
causeEn: The immediate driving force was pressure along the frontier. The core of Akkad lay in the middle and lower two rivers, while the lands to its north and north-east were held by no unified mountain peoples: the Gutians, the Lullubi and the northern populations grouped under Subartu occupied the highlands of the upper Tigris and of the upper Diyala, raided and harried the cities and towns of Akkad's orbit, and obstructed the ordinary use of the north-eastern trade routes and pastures, so that the court could not rely on collecting the tribute of that country. Sargon's own political aim was the completion of the 'King of the Four Quarters': to bring the Sumerian city-states, Akkad, Elam and the northern mountains alike under the single authority of one kingship, and thereby to consolidate the legitimacy and the divinely granted royal status he had inherited from Ningirsu's city. Cities that had been lost had to be recovered, and that formula returns again and again in the Akkadian royal narrative; it is structurally the same as the note on the card's weapon about recovering lost territory, not by coincidence but because the Mesopotamian and the Nile Valley languages of royal legitimation ran in parallel. Moreover the mountains of the north-east held the timber, the stone and the ores that a war effort needed, so that taking them was equivalent to taking the material conditions of Akkad's further growth. Every campaign in the north-east therefore carried a double meaning: it was defence and expansion at once.
impact: 東北戰役的結果，直接改變了阿卡德的地理。迪亞拉河谷與上底格里斯一線被納入王室的直屬統治：阿卡德在那一帶興建或重建城邑，設置由王室任命、帶有王室名號的總督，並把軍隊駐防與行政機構重疊配置，使原本的邊界內地化。這套模式後來被阿卡德王朝的每一代君主沿用，也被後來的三王朝時代的亞述君主用來說明自己的合法性——亞述王薩爾貢二世在公元前722年執政時特意取「薩爾貢」這個名字，正是要把自己接到這條正統線上。戰術與技術層面的遺產同樣明顯：大批銅斧、匕首、箭鏃與頭盔流入近東的武器循環，東北山區的通道被軍隊反覆走通，後來進入兩河流域的馬匹與戰車技術，也沿著這些山間通道逐步南傳。代價同樣存在：薩爾貢晚年把兵馬分散在東、北兩個方向，最後一次出征（一般認為是對埃蘭的戰役）時本人戰死，王朝隨即在內外壓力下崩潰，兩河流域此後進入長期的外族爭奪時期，而東北線的成果也隨之被反覆剝奪。
impactEn: The result of the north-eastern campaign changed the geography of Akkad directly. The line of the Diyala valley and of the upper Tigris was brought under the direct rule of the crown: Akkad founded or rebuilt towns there, appointed governors who bore the royal name, and overlapped the garrison with the administrative offices, turning what had been a frontier into interior ground. This pattern was used by every later ruler of the Akkadian dynasty and was later pressed into service by the Assyrian kings of the third millennium period to justify their own legitimacy; when the Assyrian king Sargon II took the throne in 722 BC he deliberately took the name Sargon in order to attach himself to this line of orthodoxy. The legacy in technique was just as visible: large numbers of copper axes, daggers, arrowheads and helmets entered the Near Eastern pool of arms, and the passes of the north-eastern mountains were walked repeatedly by troops, so that the horse and the chariot technique which later reached Mesopotamia also moved south along these mountain routes. The cost was there as well: in his last years Sargon spread his forces between the east and the north, and he himself was killed on what is generally taken to have been his last campaign against Elam; the dynasty then collapsed under pressure from within and without, and Mesopotamia entered a long period of struggle among incoming peoples, during which the achievements of the north-eastern line were repeatedly torn away again.
result: 以結果論，這場戰爭留下的是壓倒性的地理結果與模糊的戰鬥過程。阿卡德在東北方向的壓制成功：古提與盧魯比人的山寨被打散或被收編，迪亞拉河谷與上底格里斯一線的聚落被置於王室官員與駐軍之下，王室藉石碑把這一線的山口與高地点名為自己的領地，阿卡德在東北方由邊境前線變成內地。代價也記在銘文裡：遠征的行程以月計，糧秣要靠沿途城邑供應，軍隊在山區的每一次推進都要付出裝備與體力的損耗，而這些支出最終壓縮了王朝在埃蘭方向的餘力，使得薩爾貢的最後十年不得不在東北與東南之間兩頭用力。史料沒有留下這場戰役的確切日期、交戰地名與敵方首領姓名，因此它的戰果只能用最終的疆界與後人的正統敘事來確認：阿卡德王朝的東北疆界在薩爾貢身後被納拉姆辛與後世君主守住並記載，而薩爾貢之名得以傳世，也正是從這些東北石碑與王室「收復失地」的宣告開始。
resultEn: Judged by outcome, this war left behind an overwhelming geographical result and a hazy account of the fighting itself. Akkad's pressure in the north-east succeeded: the strongholds of the Gutians and the Lullubi were broken up or brought in, the settlements along the Diyala and the upper Tigris were placed under royal officials and royal garrisons, and by way of stelae the crown named the passes and heights of that line as its own territory, so that in the north-east Akkad changed from a forward frontier into interior country. The cost is recorded too: a distant campaign was counted in months, the grain had to come from the towns along the route, and every push into the mountains cost the army equipment and stamina, and that expenditure finally squeezed the dynasty's remaining margin in the Elamite direction, so that in the last ten years of his reign Sargon had to exert himself in the north-east and the south-east at once. The sources preserve neither the exact date, nor the place of fighting, nor the names of the enemy commanders, so the result of this war can only be confirmed from the final boundaries and from the orthodox narrative of later times: the north-eastern frontier of the Akkadian dynasty was held and written down after Sargon's death by Naram-Sin and by the rulers who followed, and the name of Sargon himself survived precisely because of those stelae of the north-east and the proclamations of a lost land recovered.
